rows.quantity: 3/4 cup (170g) unsalted butter; 2 ounces (56g) semi-sweet chocolate

steps.title: Melt
steps.note: Melt in 30-second increments, stirring after each, until completely melted and smooth.

steps.title: Combine
steps.note: Pour the warm melted butter/chocolate into the bowl with the sugar/eggs, add the vanilla, and beat or whisk to combine.

steps.title: Incorporate
steps.note: Sift the cocoa powder and flour into the batter, add the salt, then whisk or beat on low speed to incorporate.

steps.title: Fold in and spread
steps.note: Fold in the remaining 2 ounces/57g chopped chocolate and the chocolate chips. Spread it evenly into the prepared pan.

steps.title: Bake and cool
steps.note: 350°F (177°C), 28–30 minutes. Test the center with a toothpick: a few moist crumbs, no wet batter. Keep checking every 2 minutes. Cool completely in the pan on a cooling rack, lift out with the parchment, and cut into squares.

rows.quantity: 1 and 2/3 cups (333g) granulated sugar; 3 large eggs, at room temperature

steps.title: Beat together
steps.note: Beat on medium-high speed until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture is pale and ribbon-y, about 3 minutes.

rows.quantity: 1 cup (84g) unsweetened natural or Dutch-process cocoa; 1 cup (125g) all-purpose flour; 3/4 teaspoon salt

steps.title: Sift cocoa powder and flour
steps.note: Add the salt with the sifted ingredients.

rows.quantity: 2 ounces (57g) semi-sweet chocolate, coarsely chopped; 1 cup (180g) semi-sweet chocolate chips

steps.title: Prepare
steps.note: 4 ounces (113g) chopped chocolate in total, divided between melting and folding in, plus the chocolate chips.

note: Prep time: 10 minutes · Cook time: 30 minutes · Total time: 3 hours. Line the pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang on two opposite sides.
